editorial.blurb: This Yunnan noodle spot delivers cozy, comforting bowls of tender chicken and beef in perfectly balanced broths, with a genuinely warm welcome.
editorial.insiderTip: Order your noodle soup with the broth already piping hot rather than building it yourself tableside—reviewers note the pre-assembled version stays hotter and more satisfying.

topDishes.note: tender chicken in a comforting, perfectly balanced broth
sour-sweet broth that reviewers rate as good as the chicken
must-order dessert that keeps people coming back
